title: yaks key keyword vocabulary
description: The keyword @yaks/key adds to a component vocabulary. A component declaring `key` is a TAG that goes on the `key{of, value}` carrier: a key entity carrying both holds a value unique among that tag's values, so an `email` component beside `key{of, value}` records that a person is identified by that address. The keyword is named after the carrier it tags — a tag on an edge declares `edge`, a tag on a key declares `key` — so one rule reads every carrier. Which tags exist is the application's to declare.
$comment: A vocabulary declaration in the JSON Schema sense: a URI naming this keyword set, plus the schema of each keyword. A vocabulary file declares it under $vocabulary; a loader registers it with loadVocab(docs, [keyKeywords]).

key.description: This component tags a key with the kind of value it holds. `true` names the kind after the component itself (an `email` component is the `email` kind); a string names it something else, for a vocabulary where the component written and the kind queries name differ.
